# ERP check

> Free tool that estimates Singapore ERP (Electronic Road Pricing) charges for a drive: pick an
> origin, a destination and a departure time, and it returns which gantries the route crosses,
> when it crosses each one, and what each crossing costs. Estimates only — not authoritative;
> LTA / OneMotoring is the source of record.

## What it does

- Address search happens client-side against OneMap's public search API; that traffic never
  touches this site's server.
- An estimate request sends origin/destination coordinates, a departure time and a vehicle class
  to this site's API, which asks the Google Routes API for a route and matches it against gantry
  and rate data.
- The result includes the route polyline, the gantries crossed, the crossing time for each, and
  the total estimated charge.
- Nothing about a request is stored server-side; the database only holds public rate and gantry
  data.
- Access is restricted to requests Cloudflare attributes to Singapore, and rate limited to 20
  requests per minute per IP address.

## API

JSON API, same origin as the site, no authentication required.

- `POST /estimate` — body:
  `{"origin":[lat,lng],"destination":[lat,lng],"depart_at":"2026-09-22T08:00:00+08:00","vehicle":"car"}`
  → route summary, per-gantry charges and the total.
- `GET /gantries` — list of known ERP gantries with coordinates.
- `GET /rates/{gantry}?at=<ISO timestamp>` — the rate for one gantry at a given time.
- `GET /openapi.json` — OpenAPI schema for the full API.
- `GET /docs` — interactive API documentation.

## Data sources and attribution

- ERP rates: LTA DataMall's per-gantry rate tables and the ERP Rates PDF
  (https://datamall.lta.gov.sg/), under the LTA DataMall Terms of Use.
- Gantry coordinates: LTA's OneMotoring gantry KML.
- Gantry lines ("LTA Gantry (GEOJSON)") and public holidays: data.gov.sg
  (https://data.gov.sg/), under the Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0
  (https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence).
- Map display: Google Maps JavaScript API; map imagery and map data © Google
  (https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/javascript).
- Address search: OneMap (https://www.onemap.gov.sg/), © Singapore Land Authority.
- Routing: Google (Google Maps Platform / Routes API).
